text:
Nadia: Slightly urgent important question: who put a tiny paper hat on my mug and declared it the 'Ceremonial Mug of Silence'? :coffee:
Sam: that was me. It politely asked for quiet while steeping. We respected it. :shushing_face:
Doorman Dan: I recognize the Mug. New office policy: when Ceremonial Mug is in use, noise level = whisper. Also you owe it a compliment before pouring.
Rin: can we make a short ritual? 3-second silence, one compliment, and a tiny nod. I will enforce the nod. :ok_hand:
Vik: I vote for a sticker that says "I observed the Silence" for people who follow the ritual. Low-effort, high morale.
Nadia: love the sticker idea. Also suggestion: a tiny laminated card that explains the Mug's rules for new hires.
Sam: ops-bot, quick poll? Options: Sticker / Plaque / No merch.
ops-bot: Poll created: "Ceremonial Mug merch" Options: Sticker / Plaque / No merch. React to vote to cast.
Doorman Dan: voted Sticker :white_check_mark: Also instituting a small fine: anyone who breaks the silence owes the Mug a haiku and a granola token.
Rin: voted Sticker :sparkles: I already drafted a compliment: "You steep with purpose."
Vik: voted Plaque :frame_with_picture: arguing for permanence.
Nadia: voted Sticker :thumbsup: I will design a tiny sticker tonight.
Sam: also proposing a tiny sign: `When in use: 3s silence, compliment, nod` — paste to the kettle area.
Doorman Dan: adding clause: if someone steals the Ceremonial Mug for their desk, they must return it with a short apology and a pastry.
Rin: can ops-bot post a photo to #random-photos? We need provenance.
ops-bot: Photo uploaded to #random-photos: https://files.redwood/ceremonial_mug.jpg. Poll reminder scheduled: "Ceremonial Mug merch poll closes in 24h". :bell:
Vik: minor addendum: should the Mug have a title? 'Mug of Quiet Resolve' or 'Silent Steeper'?
Nadia: I like 'Mug of Quiet Resolve'. It's dramatic enough.
Sam: official naming ceremony requires ceremonial clapping (3 slow claps) and a group haiku. I will provide the haiku starter line.
Doorman Dan: I will officiate the naming and train two apprentice nodders (Marco is on probation).
Rin: ok this is now lore. Adding to onboarding draft: "How to observe the Ceremonial Mug."
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Post poll results in #random when closed". :alarm_clock:
